question: Who is known as the "Father of the Indian Renaissance" and played a pivotal role in the Bengal Renaissance movement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** is widely recognized as the "Father of the Indian Renaissance" for his substantial contributions to social and educational reforms in India during the 19th century.
 
• He founded the **Brahmo Sabha** in 1828, which later became the Brahmo Samaj, aimed at reforming and modernizing Hindu society.
 
• He was a strong advocate for the **abolition of the practice of Sati**, which led to the Sati Regulation Act of 1829.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy promoted the **education of women** and the modernization of the Indian education system by advocating for the study of science, mathematics, and English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**

 
 
• **Born:** 22 May 1772
 
• **Died:** 27 September 1833
 
• **Known for:** Social and educational reforms, abolition of Sati
 
 
 
• **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**
 
 
• **Born:** 27 June 1838
 
• **Died:** 8 April 1894
 
• **Known for:** Author of 'Vande Mataram', a prominent figure in Bengali literature
 
 
 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar**
 
 
• **Born:** 26 September 1820
 
• **Died:** 29 July 1891
 
• **Known for:** Educationist and social reformer, key figure in the Bengal Renaissance
 
 
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore**
 
 
• **Born:** 7 May 1861
 
• **Died:** 7 August 1941
 
• **Known for:** Nobel Prize-winning poet, writer, and philosopher
